cases.invariant: Split alone preserves value and changes no cash.
Entitlement becomes receivable, payment changes cash exactly once.
Entry/exit cash settlement includes both fees; margin is reserved capital, not expense.
Internal transfer neither creates return nor double-counts capital.
Endpoint FX accounting preserves interaction and flow-timing terms.
Losses reverse uncrystallized reserve; no duplicate charge when payable is later paid.

1: Equal labels but different observation calendars must not silently compare
Offsetting external flows still invalidate naive NAV return as TWR
Missing legacy metadata stays unknown, not a permissive default
2: Changing producer algorithm must be detectable by independent expected values
An unavailable upstream adapter must not produce overall passed
Expectations must never call the same production functions being tested
3: Perturb labels after the decision and confirm prior orders unchanged
Forecast publication later than decision must be rejected
Prediction values must not be silently treated as tradable monetary exposure
4: Two sleeves request more than shared settled cash; no double spending
Chunk boundaries preserve pending settlement and margin state
Equal-time event ordering and duplicate event semantics explicit
5: Changed code/config alongside data cannot be called data-only impact
Rows changed after an earlier as-of cannot alter earlier causal outputs
Unchanged input content yields no false revision impact
6: Low sample/zero variance/overlapping labels cannot imply statistical certainty
Separate stale input, model bias, cost deviation and worker failure
Prespecified thresholds and windows cannot be retrospectively selected by apparent significance
7: Read host-only sentinel, overwrite input, connect to network must fail in enforced mode
Output, memory and process-count limits must be enforced or explicitly unsupported
8: Quoted evidence containing the opposite result cannot count as correct reasoning
Scoring expected answers cannot leak into candidate input
Evidence absent, conflicts and failed experiments need explicit correct abstention/qualification
